Theorem
[Cheng's Maximal Diameter Theorem] ↗ cor:einstein-positive-scalar-curvature-compact 1. ch12:12.28

If $(M,g)$ satisfies Myers's hypotheses and $\operatorname {diam}(M)=\pi R$, then $(M,g)$ is isometric to $(S^n(R),\bar g_R)$.

Proof
